Select distinct molecule ChEMBL identifiers, compound names, and canonical SMILES for all compounds reported in document CHEMBL3833082. Join molecule_dictionary to compound_records on molregno, filter compound_records by doc_id matching the document identifier, and join compound_structures as an inner join to require canonical SMILES. Return chembl_id, compound_name, and canonical_smiles. Sort by chembl_id, compound_name, and canonical_smiles.
